fields.label: Binary path
fields.description: Path to the Codex binary used by this instance.

fields.label: CODEX_HOME path
fields.description: Custom Codex home and config directory.

fields.label: Shadow home path
fields.description: Account-specific Codex home. Keeps auth.json separate while sharing state from CODEX_HOME.

fields.label: Launch arguments
fields.description: Additional CLI arguments passed to codex app-server on session start.

fields.label: Binary path
fields.description: Path to the Claude binary used by this instance.

fields.label: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR path
fields.description: Custom Claude home and config directory. Keeps .claude.json and .claude separate.

fields.label: Auto-compact after
fields.description: Compact after 100,000 to 1,000,000 tokens. Leave empty to use Claude's default.

fields.label: Launch arguments
fields.description: Additional CLI arguments passed on session start.

environmentFields.name: CURSOR_API_KEY
environmentFields.label: Cursor API key
environmentFields.description: Required by the Cursor Agent SDK.

fields.label: Binary path
fields.description: Path to the Grok CLI binary.

environmentFields.name: HERMES_GATEWAY_TOKEN
environmentFields.label: Hermes gateway token
environmentFields.description: Shared only with the attached gateway or a Hermes Serve process launched by T3.

fields.label: Gateway endpoint
fields.description: Leave blank to use ws://127.0.0.1:9119/api/ws. T3 attaches there first and can start Hermes Serve when it is unused.

fields.label: Profile key
fields.description: Durable Hermes profile containing the sessions owned by this instance.

fields.label: Start Hermes automatically
fields.description: Attach to a compatible gateway at this endpoint, or launch and supervise `hermes serve` when no local gateway is running.

fields.label: Remote gateway
fields.description: Allow this instance to connect to a credential-free wss:// endpoint.

fields.label: Profile import
fields.description: Expose import controls only when the gateway advertises a compatible import API.

fields.label: MCP
fields.description: Allow MCP only when session-scoped registration and revocation are advertised.

fields.label: Attachments
fields.description: Allow attachment uploads supported by the connected gateway.

fields.label: Proactive mode
fields.description: Keep Hermes threads subscribed so gateway-side runs stream in on their own, and answer requests those runs raise. Off still shows that work — it arrives when the thread is opened instead.

fields.label: Voice
fields.description: Allow voice features only when explicitly supported by the gateway.

fields.label: Binary path
fields.description: Path to the OpenClaw CLI binary that exposes `openclaw acp`.

fields.label: Gateway URL
fields.description: Optional OpenClaw Gateway URL passed to `openclaw acp --url`.

fields.label: Token file
fields.description: Optional path passed to `--token-file`. The token itself is never placed on the command line.

fields.label: Password file
fields.description: Optional path passed to `--password-file`. The password itself is never placed on the command line.

fields.label: Gateway session
fields.description: Optional OpenClaw Gateway session override passed to `--session`.

fields.label: Reset gateway session
fields.description: Start `openclaw acp` with `--reset-session`.

fields.label: Binary path
fields.description: Path to a Hermes Agent CLI that exposes the `hermes acp` stdio protocol.

fields.label: Registry agent ID
fields.description: Agent identifier from the official ACP Registry, for example 'devin'.

fields.label: Executable override
fields.description: Optional local executable to use instead of installing the registry distribution. Registry arguments and environment are still applied.

fields.label: Authentication method
fields.description: Optional ACP authentication method ID. By default, the first agent-managed method is selected.

fields.label: Sign-in method
fields.description: Google account uses your Antigravity subscription. Gemini Enterprise needs a GCP project and location. API key and Agent Platform bill the credential you enter.

fields.label: API key
fields.description: Gemini API key, or a Vertex AI express key for Agent Platform. Stored in plain text on this environment.

fields.label: GCP project
fields.description: Required for Gemini Enterprise. Agent Platform uses it when no API key is set.

fields.label: GCP location
fields.description: Region for Gemini Enterprise or Agent Platform, such as us-central1.

fields.label: Binary path
fields.description: Optional path to the official Antigravity ACP executable. Leave empty for automatic selection.

fields.label: Binary path
fields.description: Path to the OpenCode binary.

fields.label: Server URL
fields.description: Leave blank to let T3 Code spawn the server when needed.

fields.label: Server password
fields.description: Stored in plain text on disk.
